es.title: Diagnóstico de problemas de DNS
es.summary: Diagnostica por qué un dominio no resuelve o no se propaga, comparando resolvedores y delegación, y propone los cambios de registro concretos.
howToAsk: /networking--dns-debug mi dominio no resuelve desde ayer
/networking--dns-debug revisa por qué el correo no llega, sospecho de los MX
/networking--dns-debug comprueba si el cambio de DNS ya se propagó
/networking--dns-debug my domain hasn't resolved since yesterday
/networking--dns-debug check why email isn't arriving, I suspect the MX records
/networking--dns-debug has my DNS change propagated yet?
en.title: DNS troubleshooting
en.summary: Diagnoses why a domain fails to resolve or propagate by comparing resolvers and delegation, then proposes specific record changes to fix it.
